speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Security and resilience are critical to Singapore’s continued survival and success.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: NSCS focuses on risks where a whole-of-Government response is needed.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: These include growing security risks in the economic and social domains.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Growing geopolitical contestation has made the global environment more uncertain and inhospitable, especially for a small country like Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Climate change affects, among others, food, water, and energy supplies.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: It can also cause extreme weather events that knock out critical infrastructure and pose risk to lives.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: This risk is exacerbated by the interdependencies across our critical infrastructure and essential services.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: For example, disruptions to power can affect internet connectivity and trigger a cascading impact on services provided over the Internet.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Strengthening social resilience is critical for a diverse, multi-racial, and multi-religious country like Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We must continue to strengthen our foundation of unity and trust in peace time, so that we will stay united as one Singapore in times of crisis.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Accelerating digitalisation poses new and enhanced risks to our social resilience and cohesion.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: While digital connectivity benefits businesses and citizens, it can also make us more susceptible to foreign influence and misinformation.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Opportunistic actors can leverage digital connectivity to exploit societal tensions and fault lines.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: As security risks become more multi-faceted and inter-linked, government agencies must build the capacity and capability to collectively address them.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore must remain vigilant and proactive in tackling traditional and emerging risks to our security and resilience.

speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: NSCS will continue to work closely with other Ministries to maintain a coherent and co-ordinated Whole-of-Government approach to protect Singapore and Singaporeans.
